title: 大閘蟹
genre: Cantonese opera aria with modern orchestra
subject: meeting a girlfriend's father for the first time over a hairy crab dinner in a restaurant private room and sending a crab leg flying out of the private-room door
caption: Cantonese opera aria with modern orchestra, a newly written comic aria in the Guangdong opera style. A gaohu leading the melody with sliding ornaments; a yangqin shimmering in tremolo; a plucked qinqin; a suona for the climaxes; wooden clappers and a wooden fish keeping the beat, with gong-and-cymbal punctuation at each section change; a soft modern string-orchestra pad underneath. Theatrical and roomy like a concert hall, gaohu and voice forward, percussion crisp, strings low. Male voice in pinghou natural chest voice, operatic Cantonese with ornamented melismas on held vowels, a comic mock-heroic delivery; opens in free rhythm, then settles into a steady middle-tempo beat. 84 BPM, F major. Mock-heroic panic over a hairy crab, then relief. No pop drum kit, no rock guitar, no Western pop ballad singing, no electronic beat, no Peking opera falsetto, no Mandarin Chinese-style pop, no autotune.
lyrics:
[Verse]
今晚初次 拜見佢老豆
酒樓房內 十個人 一圍坐定
侍應捧上 一碟大閘蟹
八足雙鉗 草繩綁實 望住我

[Pre-Chorus]
佢老豆一聲 食啦
成枱十雙眼 齊齊望住我隻手

[Chorus]
蟹呀蟹 你我今晚 一決高低
鉗仔剪刀擺滿枱 我唔知用邊件
蟹呀蟹 你唔好怪我無情
搞得掂你 我先搞得掂佢老豆

[Verse]
揭開蟹蓋 蟹膏濺到佢阿媽件衫
蟹腳一拗 飛咗出房門口
女朋友喺枱底 踢我一腳
細細聲講 蟹肺唔食得㗎

[Pre-Chorus]
佢老豆放低筷子 一聲都唔出
成間房靜到 聽到蟹鉗跌落地

[Chorus]
蟹呀蟹 你我今晚 一決高低
鉗仔剪刀擺滿枱 我唔知用邊件
蟹呀蟹 你唔好怪我無情
你個殼硬 佢老豆塊面仲硬

[Bridge]
點知佢老豆 突然拎起一隻蟹腳
教我由呢度撳落去 輕輕一拗
成條蟹肉 完完整整出嚟

[Chorus]
蟹呀蟹 你我今晚 一決高低
佢老豆坐埋嚟 一隻隻教我拆
蟹呀蟹 多謝你犧牲咗
佢話下年蟹季 記得再嚟

[Outro]
伯父 你話下年
即係 我仲有下年
